english.note: Use this when discussing something together in order to reach a decision or make arrangements.

exampleSentences.english: I want to discuss moving house with you.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我想同你商量下搬屋嘅事。

english.note: Use this when the parties discuss and decide something together rather than when one person simply asks for advice.

exampleSentences.english: Let’s consult each other about this matter first.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 dei6 soeng1 loeng4 haa5 sin1
